# 身份驗證 在Minecraft中驗證您的身份並重新驗證會話 [![構建狀態](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/axieum/authme/release.yml?branch=main&style=for-the-badge)][ci:release] [![發佈版本](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/axieum/authme?style=for-the-badge&include_prereleases&sort=semver)][releases] [![支援平台](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/versions/Available%20For_356643_latest.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge] [![下載次數](https://cf.way2muchnoise.eu/full_356643_downloads.svg?badge_style=for_the_badge)][curseforge:files]
Auth Me 是一個**Minecraft模組**，將帳號驗證功能帶入遊戲中， 旨在解決連接伺服器時常見的會話驗證錯誤問題。 這是一個**僅客戶端**的模組， 支援現代版本的[Minecraft][minecraft] Java版。 #### 替代方案 - [ReAuth][reauth_mod] by TechnicianLP - [OAuth][oauth_mod] by Sintinium ## 贊助商 我們要特別感謝以下贊助商對Auth Me開發的支持。 [][bisecthosting] ## 貢獻 感謝您考慮為Auth Me做出貢獻！請參閱 [貢獻指南][contributing]。 ## 安全漏洞 請查看[安全政策][security]了解如何回報安全漏洞。 ## 授權 Auth Me是開源軟體，採用[MIT授權][licence]。 [bisecthosting]: https://bisecthosting.com/axieum [ci:release]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/actions/workflows/release.yml [contributing]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md [curseforge]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me [curseforge:files]: https://curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/auth-me/files [fabric]: https://fabricmc.net/ [licence]: https://opensource.org/licenses/MIT [minecraft]: https://minecraft.net/ [oauth_mod]: https://github.com/Sintinium/oauth [reauth_mod]: https://github.com/TechnicianLP/ReAuth [releases]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/releases [security]: https://github.com/axieum/authme/security/policy
